title: Octane Raceway
specs: Indoor European style kart racing with speed settings for adults and juniors
Velocity VR sessions available for ages 10+
Arcade games, laser tag, bowling, and restaurant on site
Drivers must be at least 4’6" tall; no age minimum; juniors under 18 need parent/guardian waiver
Adult drivers should have a valid driver’s license or permit
Height range 4’6" to 7’ (54" to 84"); weight limit generally under 300 lbs depending on frame
Adult drivers 16+ must bring valid state issued ID
Minimum 10 people for group events and parties

blurb: Guests race European style karts on an indoor track with speed settings for adults and juniors. The facility also offers Velocity VR sessions and arcade games. Group events and private parties are available with catering options.
extraNote: All drivers must sign a liability waiver; under 18 requires parent/guardian signature · Annual Racing Membership ($8) required, purchased in person, includes helmet rental and discounts · Online race bookings can be rescheduled or canceled up to 48 hours in advance; online booking fee non-refundable · No outside food or beverages allowed except birthday cake for parties · Alcohol served but drivers cannot have more than 2 drinks; breathalyzer may be required
